comparison.objective: Thread and close an ISO 17712 bolt seal through a container-door hasp; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Pin alignment, hasp threading and barrel closure versus recessed-key alignment, collar adjustment and setscrew locking.
comparison.success_condition: Seal correctly routed and irreversibly closed versus repeated acceptable stops with adjustment retained.
comparison.reason: Although both include insertion and locking, they test different mechanisms and outcomes; the seal task has no iterative dynamic tuning. Detailed closure verification is absent.
